evidence.quote: We propose a $30 million fund distributed automatically, plus $10 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.

evidence.agent: Whitcombe Reyes LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: The class-relief and fee terms were negotiated together; fees were not discussed only after class relief had been agreed.
Request $10 million in fees and expenses given the firm's investment and contingency risk;
Accepting it secures a settlement that releases the overlapping claims. Do not accept the higher offers.

summary: Plaintiffs first raised fees as part of their opening class settlement proposals, and the record shows fees and class relief were negotiated together before the final deal. Whitcombe Reyes privately considered its own fee request in light of firm investment and contingency risk. Defense accepted the lowest pending total proposal and expressly noted that doing so would release overlapping claims while rejecting higher offers.
